panel.summary: The rawBody `verify` hook's path scoping (only /internal/yorkie/events, query-string stripped) has no test
panel.evidence: main.ts:44-56 adds logic that decides whether the raw buffer is retained, based on `req.url?.split('?',1)[0] === YORKIE_WEBHOOK_PATH`. The guard spec (yorkie-signature.guard.spec.ts) fabricates `rawBody` on a fake request object, so it cannot detect the wiring being wrong (e.g. path mismatch with the controller route, or a global-prefix change) — which would break every real webhook while all unit tests stay green. No e2e test posts to /internal/yorkie/events (grep for `internal/yorkie` in packages/backend/test returned nothing).
